verdict.rationale: SavvyCal can be driven without its UI. It offers a REST API with non-interactive personal access token / bearer auth, endpoints to create and cancel events, update and duplicate links, and query slots, plus signed webhooks with retries for event-driven automation. However, there is no CLI and no documentation of CI or headless-pipeline use. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI/pipeline integration docs or examples, and independent hands-on corroboration of automated use.
